mapper.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT IDENT2_0 AS PnProgramCode, TEXTE_0 AS PnProgramName FROM EXPLOIT.ATEXTRA ATEXTRA WHERE ATEXTRA.CODFIC_0 = 'ATABDIV' AND ATEXTRA.ZONE_0 = 'LNGDES' AND ATEXTRA.IDENT1_0 = '1005' -- Program
AND ( UPPER(ATEXTRA.IDENT2_0) = UPPER(#{PnProgram}) OR UPPER(ATEXTRA.TEXTE_0) = UPPER(#{PnProgram}) )
AND ATEXTRA.LANGUE_0 = 'ENG'
AND ATEXTRA.LANGUE_0 = #{Language}

SELECT DISTINCT IDENT2_0 AS PnFamilyCode, TEXTE_0 AS PnFamilyName FROM EXPLOIT.ATEXTRA ATEXTRA WHERE ATEXTRA.CODFIC_0 = 'ATABDIV' AND ATEXTRA.ZONE_0 = 'LNGDES' AND ATEXTRA.IDENT1_0 = '1004' -- Family
AND ( UPPER(ATEXTRA.IDENT2_0) = UPPER(#{PnFamily}) OR UPPER(ATEXTRA.TEXTE_0) = UPPER(#{PnFamily}) )
AND ATEXTRA.LANGUE_0 = 'ENG'
AND ATEXTRA.LANGUE_0 = #{Language}

SELECT DISTINCT IDENT2_0 AS PnGroup1Code, TEXTE_0 AS PnGroup1Name FROM EXPLOIT.ATEXTRA ATEXTRA WHERE ATEXTRA.CODFIC_0 = 'ATABDIV' AND ATEXTRA.ZONE_0 = 'LNGDES' AND ATEXTRA.IDENT1_0 = '20' -- Group1
AND ( UPPER(ATEXTRA.IDENT2_0) = UPPER(#{PNGroup1}) OR UPPER(ATEXTRA.TEXTE_0) LIKE UPPER('%' + #{PNGroup1} + '%') )
AND ATEXTRA.LANGUE_0 = 'ENG'
AND ATEXTRA.LANGUE_0 = #{Language}

SELECT DISTINCT IDENT2_0 AS PnGroup2Code, TEXTE_0 AS PnGroup2Name FROM EXPLOIT.ATEXTRA ATEXTRA WHERE ATEXTRA.CODFIC_0 = 'ATABDIV' AND ATEXTRA.ZONE_0 = 'LNGDES' AND ATEXTRA.IDENT1_0 = '21' -- Group2
AND ( UPPER(ATEXTRA.IDENT2_0) = UPPER(#{PNGroup2}) OR UPPER(ATEXTRA.TEXTE_0) LIKE UPPER('%' + #{PNGroup2} + '%') )
AND ATEXTRA.LANGUE_0 = 'ENG'
AND ATEXTRA.LANGUE_0 = #{Language}

SELECT DISTINCT IDENT2_0 AS PnGroup3Code, TEXTE_0 AS PnGroup3Name FROM EXPLOIT.ATEXTRA ATEXTRA WHERE ATEXTRA.CODFIC_0 = 'ATABDIV' AND LANGUE_0 = 'ENG' AND ATEXTRA.ZONE_0 = 'LNGDES' AND ATEXTRA.IDENT1_0 = '22' -- Group3
AND ( UPPER(ATEXTRA.IDENT2_0) = UPPER(#{PNGroup2}) OR UPPER(ATEXTRA.TEXTE_0) LIKE UPPER('%' + #{PNGroup2} + '%') )
AND ATEXTRA.LANGUE_0 = 'ENG'
AND ATEXTRA.LANGUE_0 = #{Language}

SELECT #{PN} AS PN
UNION SELECT DISTINCT ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 AS PN FROM EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER ITMMASTER LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.ECCSTA ECCSTA ON ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 = ECCSTA.ITMREF_0 WHERE ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 LIKE #{PN} + '%' OR ( ECCSTA.ITMREF_0 + '_' + ECCSTA.ECCVALMAJ_0 = #{PN} )
UNION SELECT ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 AS PN FROM EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER ITMMASTER WHERE LEFT (ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0, 4) = 'PNOG' AND ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 LIKE '%' + #{PN} + '%'
UNION SELECT ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 AS PN FROM EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER ITMMASTER WHERE LEFT (ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0, 4) = 'PNOG' AND ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 LIKE '%' + #{PN} + '%'
UNION SELECT TRIM(ITMBPS.ITMREFBPS_0) AS PN FROM EXPLOIT.ITMBPS ITMBPS WHERE TRIM(ITMBPS.ITMREF_0) = #{PN} UNION SELECT ITMBPS.ITMREF_0 AS PN FROM EXPLOIT.ITMBPS ITMBPS WHERE TRIM(ITMBPS.ITMREFBPS_0) = #{PN} UNION SELECT ITMBPC.ITMREF_0 AS PN FROM EXPLOIT.ITMBPC ITMBPC WHERE TRIM(ITMBPC.ITMREFBPC_0) = #{PN} UNION SELECT TRIM(ITMBPC.ITMREFBPC_0) AS PN FROM EXPLOIT.ITMBPC ITMBPC WHERE TRIM(ITMBPC.ITMREF_0) = #{PN}
mapper.select: WITH T_PN AS ( ), T_PN_PROGRAM AS ( ), T_PN_FAMILY AS ( ), T_PN_GROUP1 AS ( ), T_PN_GROUP2 AS ( ), T_PN_GROUP3 AS ( ) SELECT DISTINCT ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 AS PNROOT, ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 AS PN, ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 ) + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 ) AS Description, T_PN_PROGRAM.PnProgramCode, T_PN_PROGRAM.PnProgramName, T_PN_FAMILY.PnFamilyCode, T_PN_FAMILY.PnFamilyName, T_PN_GROUP1.PnGroup1Code, T_PN_GROUP1.PnGroup1Name, T_PN_GROUP2.PnGroup2Code, T_PN_GROUP2.PnGroup2Name, T_PN_GROUP3.PnGroup3Code, T_PN_GROUP3.PnGroup3Name FROM T_PN INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER ON ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 = T_PN.PN LEFT JOIN T_PN_PROGRAM ON ITMMASTER.CCE_1 = T_PN_PROGRAM.PnProgramCode LEFT JOIN T_PN_FAMILY ON ITMMASTER.CCE_1 = T_PN_FAMILY.PnFamilyCode LEFT JOIN T_PN_GROUP1 ON ITMMASTER.TSICOD_0 = T_PN_GROUP1.PnGroup1Code LEFT JOIN T_PN_GROUP2 ON ITMMASTER.TSICOD_1 = T_PN_GROUP2.PnGroup2Code LEFT JOIN T_PN_GROUP3 ON ITMMASTER.TSICOD_2 = T_PN_GROUP3.PnGroup3Code ORDER BY ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 ASC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

-- Suppliers PN SELECT BPARTNER.BPRNUM_0 AS BPCode, BPARTNER.BPRSHO_0 AS BPName, ITMREFBPS_0 AS OptionPN, IIF ( ITMDESBPS_0 != '', ITMDESBPS_0, ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 ) + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 ) ) AS Description FROM EXPLOIT.ITMBPS ITMBPS LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.BPARTNER ON ITMBPS.BPSNUM_0 = BPARTNER.BPRNUM_0 LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER ON ITMBPS.ITMREF_0 = ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 WHERE ITMBPS.ITMREF_0 = #{PN} AND ITMBPS.ITMREF_0 != ITMBPS.ITMREFBPS_0 -- Suppliers PN2 UNION SELECT '00000' AS BPCode, 'DEDIENNE' AS BPName, ITMREFBPS_0 AS OptionPN, IIF ( ITMDESBPS_0 != '', ITMDESBPS_0, ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 ) + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 ) ) AS Description FROM EXPLOIT.ITMBPS ITMBPS LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER ON ITMBPS.ITMREF_0 = ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 WHERE TRIM(ITMBPS.ITMREFBPS_0) = #{PN} AND ITMBPS.ITMREF_0 != ITMBPS.ITMREFBPS_0 -- Customer PN UNION SELECT BPARTNER.BPRNUM_0 AS BPCode, BPARTNER.BPRSHO_0 AS BPName, ITMREFBPC_0 AS OptionPN, IIF ( ITMDESBPC_0 != '', ITMDESBPC_0, ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 ) + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 ) ) AS Description FROM EXPLOIT.ITMBPC ITMBPC LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.BPARTNER ON ITMBPC.BPCNUM_0 = BPARTNER.BPRNUM_0 LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER ON ITMBPC.ITMREF_0 = ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 WHERE ITMBPC.ITMREF_0 = #{PN} AND ITMBPC.ITMREF_0 != ITMBPC.ITMREFBPC_0 -- Customer PN2 UNION SELECT '00000' AS BPCode, 'DEDIENNE' AS BPName, ITMREFBPC_0 AS OptionPN, IIF ( ITMDESBPC_0 != '', ITMDESBPC_0, ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 ) + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 ) ) AS Description FROM EXPLOIT.ITMBPC ITMBPC LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER ON ITMBPC.ITMREF_0 = ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 WHERE TRIM(ITMBPC.ITMREFBPC_0) = #{PN} AND ITMBPC.ITMREF_0 != ITMBPC.ITMREFBPC_0
UNION SELECT '00000' AS BPCode, 'DEDIENNE' AS BPName, ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 AS OptionPN, ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 ) + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 ) AS Description FROM EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER ITMMASTER WHERE LEFT (ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0, 4) = 'PNOG' AND ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 LIKE '%' + #{PN} + '%'
UNION SELECT '00000' AS BPCode, 'DEDIENNE' AS BPName, ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 AS OptionPN, ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 ) + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 ) AS Description FROM EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER ITMMASTER WHERE LEFT (ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0, 4) = 'PNOG' AND ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 LIKE '%' + #{PN} + '%'

WITH T_PN AS ( ), T_PN_PROGRAM AS ( ), T_PN_FAMILY AS ( ), T_PN_GROUP1 AS ( ), T_PN_GROUP2 AS ( ), T_PN_GROUP3 AS ( ), T0 AS ( SELECT ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 AS PNROOT, IIF ( ITMMASTER.ECCFLG_0 = 2, ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 + '_' + ECCSTA.ECCVALMAJ_0, ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 ) AS PN, ITMMASTER.TCLCOD_0 AS Cat, ECCSTA.ECCVALMAJ_0 AS Version, ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 ) + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 ) AS Description, ITMMASTER.YITM_COMSTA_0 AS Comment, IIF (ECCSTA.EXNFLG_0 = 2, 5, ITMMASTER.ITMSTA_0) AS Status, ITMMASTER.CREDAT_0 AS CreateDate, T_PN_PROGRAM.PnProgramCode, T_PN_PROGRAM.PnProgramName, T_PN_FAMILY.PnFamilyCode, T_PN_FAMILY.PnFamilyName, T_PN_GROUP1.PnGroup1Code, T_PN_GROUP1.PnGroup1Name, T_PN_GROUP2.PnGroup2Code, T_PN_GROUP2.PnGroup2Name, T_PN_GROUP3.PnGroup3Code, T_PN_GROUP3.PnGroup3Name FROM T_PN INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER ON T_PN.PN = ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.ECCSTA ECCSTA ON ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 = ECCSTA.ITMREF_0 LEFT JOIN T_PN_PROGRAM ON ITMMASTER.CCE_1 = T_PN_PROGRAM.PnProgramCode LEFT JOIN T_PN_FAMILY ON ITMMASTER.CCE_1 = T_PN_FAMILY.PnFamilyCode LEFT JOIN T_PN_GROUP1 ON ITMMASTER.TSICOD_0 = T_PN_GROUP1.PnGroup1Code LEFT JOIN T_PN_GROUP2 ON ITMMASTER.TSICOD_1 = T_PN_GROUP2.PnGroup2Code LEFT JOIN T_PN_GROUP3 ON ITMMASTER.TSICOD_2 = T_PN_GROUP3.PnGroup3Code ) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY T0.Version DESC ) AS ID, T0.PNROOT, T0.PN, T0.Cat, T0.Version, T0.Description, T0.Comment, T0.Status, T0.CreateDate, PnProgramCode, PnProgramName, PnFamilyCode, PnFamilyName, PnGroup1Code, PnGroup1Name, PnGroup2Code, PnGroup2Name, PnGroup3Code, PnGroup3Name FROM T0

SELECT CAST(YITMINDUS.YCHKDWG_0 AS SMALLINT) AS checkDrawing, APLSTD.LANMES_0 typo, YITMINDUS.YCOMPLEX_0 complex, CAST(YITMINDUS.YWAROUT_0 AS SMALLINT) AS warnManufTool, CAST(YITMINDUS.YWARCE_0 AS SMALLINT) AS warnCE, CAST(YITMINDUS.YWAREXTRA_0 AS SMALLINT) AS warnExtraSize, CAST(YITMINDUS.YWARCAST_0 AS SMALLINT) AS warnCasters, CAST(YITMINDUS.YWARLIFT_0 AS SMALLINT) AS warnLifting, CAST(YITMINDUS.YCOMCOM_0 AS SMALLINT) AS isComponents, CAST(YITMINDUS.YMATALU_0 AS SMALLINT) AS rawAluminum, CAST(YITMINDUS.YMATSTL_0 AS SMALLINT) AS rawSteel, CAST(YITMINDUS.YMATPLA_0 AS SMALLINT) AS rawPlastic, CAST(YITMINDUS.YMATVAR_0 AS SMALLINT) AS rawVariousMaterial, CAST(YITMINDUS.YMATSPE_0 AS SMALLINT) AS rawSpecific, CAST(YITMINDUS.YTTHHTRT_0 AS SMALLINT) AS heatTreatment, CAST(YITMINDUS.YMACGEA_0 AS SMALLINT) AS machineGrinding, CAST(YITMINDUS.YMACGRI_0 AS SMALLINT) AS machineGear, CAST(YITMINDUS.YTTSSTD_0 AS SMALLINT) AS ttsStand, CAST(YITMINDUS.YTTSSPE_0 AS SMALLINT) AS ttsSpecific, CAST(YITMINDUS.YTTSPAI_0 AS SMALLINT) AS ttsPainting, CAST(YITMINDUS.YTTSPLC_0 AS SMALLINT) AS ttsPlastic, CAST(YITMINDUS.YPCKSPB_0 AS SMALLINT) AS specialPackingBox, CAST(YITMINDUS.YCONLOT_0 AS SMALLINT) AS testLoad, CAST(YITMINDUS.YCONHYD_0 AS SMALLINT) AS testHydraulic, CAST(YITMINDUS.YCONBAT_0 AS SMALLINT) AS testBalancing, CAST(YITMINDUS.YCONVAR_0 AS SMALLINT) AS testVarious, CAST(YITMINDUS.YCONCAL_0 AS SMALLINT) AS controlCalibration, CAST(YITMINDUS.YCONSPE_0 AS SMALLINT) AS controlSpecific, CAST(YITMINDUS.YCONGEO_0 AS SMALLINT) AS control3D FROM EXPLOIT.YITMINDUS YITMINDUS LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.APLSTD APLSTD ON APLSTD.LAN_0 = 'ENG' AND LANCHP_0 = '6557' AND APLSTD.LANNUM_0 = YITMINDUS.YFAMPN_0 WHERE ITMREF_0 = #{PN}
SELECT TOP 1 ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 FROM ITMMASTER WHERE ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 = #{PN}
SELECT ECCSTA.ECCVALMAJ_0 AS Version FROM ITMMASTER LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.ECCSTA AS ECCSTA ON ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 = ECCSTA.ITMREF_0 WHERE ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 = #{PN} AND ECCSTA.ECCSTA_0 = 2

SELECT IIF ( ITMMASTER.ECCFLG_0 = 2, ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 + '_' + ECCSTA.ECCVALMAJ_0, ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 ) AS PN, ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 ) + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 ) AS Description, IIF ( ECCSTA.EXNFLG_0 = 2, 'Obsolete', ( CASE WHEN ITMMASTER.ITMSTA_0 = 1 THEN 'Active' WHEN ITMMASTER.ITMSTA_0 = 2 THEN 'InDevelopment' WHEN ITMMASTER.ITMSTA_0 = 3 THEN 'OnShortage' WHEN ITMMASTER.ITMSTA_0 = 4 THEN 'NotRenewed' WHEN ITMMASTER.ITMSTA_0 = 5 THEN 'Obsolete' WHEN ITMMASTER.ITMSTA_0 = 6 THEN 'NotUsable' ELSE 'UNK' END ) ) AS PNStatus, ITMMASTER.YITM_SUP_0 AS WC, IIF ( SORDERQ.YSOQ_PJTORI_0 = '', SORDERQ.YSOH_PJT_0, SORDERQ.YSOQ_PJTORI_0 ) AS ProjectNO, SORDER.BPCORD_0 AS CustomerCode, SORDER.BPCNAM_0 AS CustomerName FROM EXPLOIT.SORDERQ AS SORDERQ LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDER ON SORDERQ.SOHNUM_0 = SORDER.SOHNUM_0 LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.ECCSTA AS ECCSTA ON SORDERQ.ITMREF_0 = ECCSTA.ITMREF_0 AND SORDERQ.ECCVALMAJ_0 = ECCSTA.ECCVALMAJ_0 LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER AS ITMMASTER ON ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 = SORDERQ.ITMREF_0 WHERE SORDERQ.SOQSTA_0 != 3 AND ITMMASTER.ITMSTA_0 != 1 AND SORDERQ.SALFCY_0 = #{Site}
SELECT STRING_AGG (T_PN.PN, ';') AS OptionPN FROM AS T_PN WHERE T_PN.PN != #{PN}
